senses.sense_definition: An exclamation used to show contempt, disbelief, or derision.

examples.text: "<w>Posh</w>!" he cried, snapping his fingers at the ridiculous suggestion.

target_lang_translations.es: «¡<w>Tonterías</w>!» gritó, chasqueando los dedos ante la sugerencia ridícula.
